text:
jia: Quick thread  thinking about adding a small error-injection plugin to the switchover coordinator to exercise rollback/fallback in staging. want feedback on safety/telemetry/ops.

sam: Sounds useful. Are we talking targeted injections during the canary window (delay/drop new pool) or general chaos?

jia: Targeted only. Examples: delay new-variant responses by X ms for Y% of sessions, drop KV warmup for subset, fail probe checks. Not broad chaos.

maria: We have an offline simulator but it misses orchestration edge-cases. Hitting the real controller would find gaps. +1 but keep it out of prod.

noah: Key tradeoffs: accidental prod impact, coordinator complexity, noisy alerts. Staging-first and RBAC needed. Also auditability for injected-caused rollbacks.

jia: Agreed. Plan: feature-flag + RBAC + staging-only by default; explicit operator override for pre-prod. Fail-open if the injection subsystem errors.

elaine: Telemetry concerns: tag injected runs so SLOs/alerts can filter. Suggest events injection.start / injection.stop with profile_id + rollout_id.

sam: API sketch: coordinator accepts injection_profile on rollout create. ActionPlane subscribes and executes controls locally. Keeps decision vs execution boundaries clear.

maria: Runtime should run shimmed/sandboxed handlers and enforce quotas. Also need an operator kill-switch to immediately stop active injections.

noah: Persist metadata: rollout.metadata.injected=true and injection_id. Also emit events to our event stream rather than mutating core state directly. Easier to replay.

jia: Two modes: "mock-decision" (no runtime calls) for CI + perf tests, and "live-inject" for integration.

elaine: Alerting: suppress pages for injected runs unless severity exceeds threshold. Add filters in alerting rules.

sam: Long-term: split coordinator into DecisionPlane (policy/eval) + Orchestrator that talks to ActionPlanes. Makes plugin surface cleaner.

maria: I'll prototype runtime shim; sam will draft API; noah will define event schema + audit fields; elaine will update telemetry filters.
